evidence.detail: Achievements are sorted by -ad.percent (descending by percent of players who have earned each achievement)
The 'Player' achievement (play any match) is a BooleanAchievement that nearly all active players earn, giving it a ~100% rate and placing it first in the sorted list
desc.percent = a.percent(season_id=season_id) — this is the field driving the sort

triage.notes: The decision needed is what ordering to replace sort-by-percent with: alphabetical, by achievement rarity (inverted percent), by type/category, or a manually curated order. The issue text explicitly says 'Think about the order' rather than specifying the desired outcome.
